thread:
Maya: Hey team — draft of the launch blog is ready for a quick sweep. Google doc here: https://docs.google.com/draft-redwood-launch (comments turned on). Main asks: tighten headline, confirm benchmark framing, and sign off on webinar CTA.
Tom: Opening now. quick ask — can we lead with the customer ROI stat (latency + cost) rather than feature laundry list?
Maya: Yep — current lead options below. leaning toward #2 but open.
Maya: 1) Build predictable inference that scales. 2) Cut inference costs without trading latency. 3) One runtime for hosted, dedicated, private.
Raj: +1 on option 2. Marketing should call out the exact benchmark numbers (not vague). suggest: "~30% lower cost per token, 2x throughput under 95th-pct latency target" if legal ok.
Nora: Can we avoid the percent sign without source? Give exact phrasing to attribute: e.g., "Internal benchmark: 30% lower cost per token vs baseline infra (details in appendix)". Also, include a data retention/legal blurb for Private customers.
Zoe: For GTM, make sure the blog includes UTM and webinar registration flow so we capture MQLs. Proposed CTA placement: end of hero + inline CTA after bench callout.
Maya: Good. Draft CTA text: "See the benchmarks and join our launch webinar — reserve your spot". UTM snippet we plan to use: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q2`
Liza: Quick product ask — please mention fallback routing (model variant fallback) as the reliability story. one sentence under ops paragraph.
Tom: Design — Maya, can you drop hero image notes? Zoe, can your growth team own the registration page mapping?
Maya: Hero notes: engineer at terminal + side-by-side perf charts (small). I'll add asset desc in doc.
Zoe: I'll own registration mapping to HubSpot. note to eng: need a hidden field `redwood_plan` on the form.
SchedulingBot: Reminder: proposed publish date set to 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC — confirm or change with `/reschedule`
Raj: Timeline ok but we should align with webinar on 2026-04-15 (webinar registration needs 1 week lead).
Maya: Ok scheduling adjusted in doc. also prepping a short benchmark appendix for ops/bench team.
Nora: Legal quick pass: I'll review the benchmark appendix and the claims by EOD today. please add method bullets: baseline hardware, sequence lengths, quantization.
Tom: Approvals: design signoff (Liza), legal (Nora), PM (Raj), growth (Zoe). Once all checkboxes done, we can set publish.
Liza: Design nod — will upload hero + chart PNGs by tomorrow noon.
Maya: Small copy ask — can someone check H2: "How we measured: latency SLOs and cost per token" -> maybe reword for non-technical readers.
Raj: Suggest: "How we measured performance and cost" for clarity.
Zoe: Also add one sentence about inbound routing: "Leads from the blog will be routed to Growth queue A with tag 'dedicated-launch' and priority=high". Maya pls confirm text.
Maya: Added that line. HubSpot mapping: `lead.source=blog`, `lead.campaign=dedicated_launch_q2`, `lead.origin=organic`
Nora: Legal: approved tentative wording for the headline claim provided method bullets added. final sign-off once appendix numbers are attached.
Tom: Great. final editorial pass tomorrow morning, then we lock. Maya — can you paste the final headline options in chat when ready so I can pick? :thumbsup:
Maya: Will do. thanks everyone — will update the doc and ping when assets are in.
Zoe: 👍
Liza: 👍
Nora: ✅
